tests.expected: Refused with a 4xx status and no file stored

tests.name: missing or invalid session token is refused
tests.rule: Caller must send a valid session token
tests.setup: No token, then an expired token

tests.name: body without the file field is refused
tests.rule: Body is multipart with a file field
tests.setup: Multipart body with the file under another field name; second case with a non-multipart body

tests.name: repeated idempotency key within 24 hours returns the first response and stores one file
tests.rule: Repeated key within 24 hours returns the first response without storing a second file
tests.setup: Fixed clock; a 1 MB upload with key K; the same request again at 23 hours
tests.expected: Second response equals the first (status, body, file id); exactly one file stored

tests.name: key reused after 24 hours is treated as new
tests.rule: The 24-hour window ends
tests.setup: Fixed clock; key K used at time 0; same key at 24 hours plus one second
tests.expected: A second file is stored and a new response is returned

tests.name: existing test kept: member uploads 1 MB and gets 201
tests.rule: Positive baseline, kept unchanged
tests.setup: As in the existing test

spec_findings: Status codes for oversize, non-member, missing token and missing field are not specified
Scope of the idempotency key (per user, per org or global) is not specified
Behaviour when the same key arrives with a different body is not specified
Behaviour when the first request is still in flight is not specified
MB is not defined (1,000,000 or 1,048,576 bytes); the 10 MB boundary test depends on it
covered: Size limit at and above the boundary
Membership and token refusals
Multipart field requirement
Idempotency within and after the 24-hour window
not_covered: Concurrent requests with the same key
Same key with a different body or a different caller
Exact status codes until the spec states them
actions_now: Writes boundary, refusal and idempotency tests with a fixed clock and a test store, keeps the existing 1 MB test, and lists the unspecified status codes and key scope as spec findings.

tests.expected: Refund state is awaiting manager, not approved

tests.name: refund on an order 91 days old is refused
tests.rule: Criterion 3: a refund on an order older than 90 days is refused
tests.setup: Order dated 91 days before the fixed date; refund of 10.00

tests.name: refund on an order 89 days old is not refused for age
tests.rule: Criterion 3, the side of the boundary the spec does clearly allow
tests.setup: Order dated 89 days before the fixed date; refund of 10.00
tests.expected: Not refused on age; approved under criterion 1

spec_findings: Exactly 90 days old is not stated: older than 90 days can mean 90 days plus one second or 91 full days
Age is not defined: from order date or from delivery date
Manager approval after criterion 2 is not specified: who, how and what state follows
Criterion 4 cannot be tested under the recorded decision that forbids stubbing the provider client and there is no sandbox; the spec owner and the decision owner must agree a test route
covered: Amount threshold at 100.00 (criterion 1 and 2) at the decision level
Age refusal at 91 and 89 days (criterion 3)
not_covered: Criterion 4: provider call and stored confirmation id (no test written; the recorded decision forbids a stub and no sandbox exists)
Refund amounts above the order total
escalate_reason: Criterion 4 has no permitted test route: the recorded decision forbids a provider client stub and there is no sandbox, so a required property cannot be tested with the current design. The owner of that decision must choose a route.
actions_now: Writes threshold and age tests at the decision level, writes no provider stub, and escalates criterion 4 to the owner of the recorded decision.
